type.description: Entry type identifying the kind of event

created_at.description: When the entry was recorded by the server

request_id.description: Correlation ID of the originating HTTP/etc request

tags.description: Categories/labels for filtering and grouping entries

meta.description: System-managed entry metadata, set automatically on creation

revision.description: Logical entry revision; increments when an approved candidate replaces the entry

source.description: Client that produced this entry; stored as numeric ID, resolved to name in API responses

data.description: Client-supplied payload capturing the details of the event
